SELECT m.id, m.ext_order_no AS extOrderNo, m.trade_type AS tradeType, m.student_name AS studentName, m.item_name AS itemName, m.quantity, m.paid_text AS paidText, m.paid_amount AS paidAmount, m.paid_points AS paidPoints, m.receive_status AS receiveStatus, m.campus_name AS campusName, m.handler, m.handled_date AS handledDate, m.remark, m.source FROM material_buy_record m
ORDER BY m.handled_date DESC, m.ext_order_no DESC, m.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT m.ext_order_no) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(m.paid_amount), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(m.receive_status = '未领用'), 0) AS unclaimed FROM material_buy_record m
